summary: MUST SEE FAMILY HOME Viewing is highly recommended on this modern three bedroom mid terraced property. Located close to commuting road, and within walking distance of many amenities, including schools and shops. This home has been upgraded to a very high standard and briefly comprises of, spacious lounge, open plan kitchen with appliances, 3 good sized bedrooms and family bathroom with shower. There is gas central heating and double glazing to compliment. The rent does not include bills or council tax
